method: Manual native branch tracing, literal checks and hashed code ranges. A: numbers/conditions/effects. B: public framework field names. No target code was run.

sms.initializer: 0x886240c8 calls capacity(alphabet=0 or 2, extra_header=0) and capacity(alphabet=2, extra_header=0); explicitly shifts the UCS2 byte outputs right by one. Settings 1/2 use alphabet 2 for the default slots. Others use alphabet 0. Current device setting was not read.
sms.formula: used=str_len for UCS2, otherwise uint16(str_len+default_ext+r8_two). page=1 when used<=single or multi=0, else floor((used-1)/multi)+1. remaining=uint16(single-used) on single/zero-multi branch, else (multi-used%multi)%multi.
sms.important_difference: When r8_two>0, page count uses r8_two capacities only if language fields +250/+254/+256 are nonzero; remaining count always uses r8_two. Preserve both branches. UI division does not split ESC pairs; send segmentation is separate.
sms.scope: Shared SMS TextEdit widget, called by SMS body menu at 0x883989d4. Per-character classification is recorded in sms-character-tables.json; actual selected encoding/shift configuration remains external. Phonebook post-adjustment at 351bb2 is excluded from the SMS model.

format_parser.digits: accumulate uint32 decimal across format bytes; star replaces accumulator with 1024; final zero or >1024 becomes 1024; masks OR except unknown resets mask

browser_progress.page_received: store payload[0] as total media count; reset current media and byte progress; clear request handle; if total==0 clear loading and set stopped parameters
browser_progress.media_received: increment current. If current<total, display(current+total,2*total); otherwise clear loading and stop parameters/UI via 0x88b62c02.
browser_progress.page_stopped: query request state; set stopped parameters. States 1/2/3 preserve current loading, others clear it and refresh stopped UI. Do not turn every stop notification into cancellation of the latest request.

browser_select.confirm: e001/e004/fa16/fa1b: multiple stays open, single commits widget selection and closes. XHTML dispatches callback event 7 only if flags changed.
browser_select.back: e002/fa17: single closes without commit; multiple commits and closes. XHTML multi Back does NOT call 629878 change dispatch.

browser_select.xhtml_commit: b48534 iterates all options; write option+5a from widget item checked flag. If single, each checked item writes select+70=index (last checked wins if inconsistent state). changed is OR of old/new differences. Always call 62974c -> bfd58 after loop.
browser_select.wml_commit: b482c2 writes option+4 from widget. Single selected option goes to affaee; otherwise affb92. WML task/value side effects remain delegated.

browser_form_actions.checkbox: type2 with guards node+8f/+90 zero toggles node+8e BEFORE click callback node+24 event3; callback false or changed type returns without local rollback. Passed checks redraw via bf06a.
browser_form_actions.radio: guards +8f/+90; iterate form list or layout list, candidate tag must equal 0x000a0255 and type3; compare names using b276a6/b27782 then clear selected peer flags, select current and redraw. Exact string comparison semantics/DOM lifetime remain unresolved.
browser_form_actions.submit: type4 checks form callback+130 (event3), then walks linked form controls. Type0/1 validation uses null-value guard at input+114 and helper bebc6; failure b46656. Non-input or other input type takes beff0 submit exit, so do not claim exhaustive validation of every later field. Submit b5562a(form+4c,layout,node,flag=0). Type7 submits flag=1 directly.
browser_form_actions.reset: type5 checks form callback+134 event3; if permitted calls bea84(form+4c,layout), clears layout+21a and redraws. Text/password free current value and copy default from node+68 to node+60; checkbox/radio copy default node+91 to checked+8e. Select guarded by +7d, options copy +5c to +5a and checked options set select+70=index. If nonmultiple, size<=1 and index==0, set first option selected. This is exact numeric fallback, not inferred DOM-standard behavior.

sms_send_storage.names: B: fixed public mmisms_send.c corroborates native calls/offset usage. Numeric branches and stores are A.
sms_send_storage.wait: need_save != 0 and save_storage == 0 -> send_status=1 and return without advancing segment or destination
sms_send_storage.saved: need_save != 0 and save_storage != 0 -> b51c90(dual,storage,id,4,1,0,0,ctx,5), backsend_status=5, send_result=0, storage=0; then continue
sms_send_storage.continue: next segment first: sequence uint8(current+1) -> 3c3296. Otherwise clear successful recipient, move to next destination if possible, initialize result, call 3c37dc. No destination/move failure/return 4 -> 3c2be2(dual,1,1).

write_status.1: finished=1,storage=0; next segment or clear recipient and move to next destination
write_status.3/4: finished=1,storage=0; skip remaining segments and move to next destination
write_status.5: if more segments: set global and current operation=12; b51936 saves next segment. Error 8 opens No-space continuation; other error shows Error and closes send window(0). If no more segments move to next destination.

sms_send_storage.write_exit: all normal branches clear send_status=0; missing context returns without store
limits: this is continuation after write-confirm processing, not the entire modem callback
storage physical writes, complete folder/index logic and all error handlers remain outside these rules
high-level synthetic SmsApp retains explicit policy state and is not a native modem emulator
